title: 2024 HMMT February Guts Problem 4
statement: Equilateral triangles \(A B F\) and \(B C G\) are constructed outside regular pentagon \(A B C D E\). Compute \(\angle F E G\).

solutions.text:
We have \(\angle F E G=\angle A E G-\angle A E F\). Since \(E G\) bisects \(\angle A E D\), we get \(\angle A E G=54^{\circ}\).
Now, \(\angle E A F=108^{\circ}+60^{\circ}=168^{\circ}\). Since triangle \(E A F\) is isosceles, this means \(\angle A E F=6^{\circ}\), so the answer is \(54^{\circ}-6^{\circ}=48^{\circ}\).
